title: Wall-slam B — Orthen furnace / masterwork / tectonic / Waiko bonecrusher
userRulings: Orthen furnace needs Wildy (Forinthry) + Desert + Anachronia
Masterwork bar fold anywhere (Asgarnia Artisans not a hard gate for plate/glorious-bar fold)
POP / Waiko often Asgarnia Arc (not Desert hub for Boni sinks)
policy: Catalog is read-only this pass — decisions only for scripts/wall-slam-apply-high.mjs
action keepHosts | primary | remove | wall; apply merges confidence high|medium only
Orthen CRAFT pressure (plate→core) is Wildy+Desert+Anachronia; Asgarnia is optional plate-hub host only
Orthen USAGE stacks (Superheat / autoheater) keep Tirannwn and/or Forinthry as hard gates separate from craft
Base masterwork fold is region-free; T92 trim essence and custom-fit geography stay Asgarnia+Morytania

decisions.name: Masterwork plate → Orthen furnace core pressure stack
decisions.reason: User: Orthen furnace needs Wildy+Desert+Anachronia. Masterwork bar fold anywhere → Asgarnia stays as optional plate-hub host only, not in requiredRegions. Matches prior applied ruling KEEP on [forinthry,desert,anachronia,asgarnia] req=[forinthry,desert,anachronia]. Drop pure asgarnia+anachronia hard pair.
notes: Dragon burners = Anachronia Orthen Observation outpost
Draconic energy self-source pressure = Forinthry/Daemonheim ED infrastructure (Wildy)
Desert pressure = self-source consumable/material geography on the core craft (user hard gate)
Curved masterwork plates consume folded bars — fold is global Smithing, not Artisans-locked

decisions.name: Orthen furnace core + Superheat Form + smithing autoheater stack
decisions.reason: USAGE stack, not craft-materials row. All three hard: Anachronia furnace core + Tirannwn Superheat Form + Forinthry advanced smithing autoheater. Asgarnia plate pressure is optional only (not a host). Do not swap this set for Wildy+Desert+Anachronia — that ruling is the craft/plate-pressure row.
notes: Clamp foreign hosts (esp. asgarnia) if they reappear

decisions.name: Orthen furnace core full skilling stack
decisions.reason: Narrower Superheat-sustain package: Anachronia core + Tirannwn Superheat Form. Autoheater is optional partner already covered by the three-region superheat-autoheater stack — do not force Forinthry onto this dual. Keep multi-ok both hosts with matching requiredRegions.
notes: cross-region:orthen-furnace-core-stack; piece row anachronia:orthen-furnace-core stays single-home

decisions.name: Masterwork Spear of Annihilation
decisions.reason: Trim/essence lock mirrors trimmed masterwork: Asgarnia praesulic + Morytania malevolent. Anachronia is archaeology-hint only on the base spear path — drop as host so it does not pollute multi-host clamps. Masterwork bar fold anywhere does not remove the T92 essence pair.

decisions.name: Masterwork ranged armour material pressure (Havenhythe/Anachronia Hunter)
decisions.reason: Support densify, not a hard BiS lock. Havenhythe is starting free value for apex-hide / masterwork ranged pressure; full recipe still partial vs Equilibrium. Empty requiredRegions so it does not force Anachronia elective. Drop anachronia host — BGH remains detail/hint only until recipe is locked.
decisions.wallIfWrong: If recipe later hard-requires Anachronia BGH materials, reopen as keepHosts [havenhythe, anachronia] with non-empty requiredRegions — do not invent all_required now.

decisions.name: Trimmed / custom-fit trimmed masterwork melee armour
decisions.reason: T92 trim self-source: Morytania malevolent essence + Asgarnia Torva/praesulic + Elof custom-fit. User 'masterwork bar fold anywhere' applies to base plates/glorious bars only — not this essence pair. Multi-ok both hosts with all_required both.
notes: Sibling single-home: Custom-fit trimmed masterwork (Elof / Master Crafter) stays asgarnia-only

decisions.name: Elite tectonic robe armour
decisions.reason: True no-trade multi: Asgarnia Vorago tectonic + Virtus/praesulic; Forinthry draconic energy + chaotic remnant / Daemonheim. Do not collapse to Asgarnia-only. Multi-ok both with all_required both.

decisions.name: Bonecrusher auto-pickup upgrade (Waiko / Boni)
decisions.reason: User: POP/Waiko often Asgarnia Arc — Boni taijitu sink is Asgarnia, not Desert. Forinthry still hard for base bonecrusher purchase (Daemonheim rewards). Dual keepHosts with both required. Do not re-emit forinthry:bonecrusher base as this row.
notes: Desert is support only for Arc geography debates — not a host on this upgrade
Pairs with multi-region:toolbelt-bonecrusher-attach when that row is filed

walls.name: Masterwork ranged armour material pressure (Havenhythe/Anachronia Hunter)
walls.question: If 2026 masterwork ranged recipe is later confirmed to hard-require Anachronia BGH materials (not just optional hide pressure), reopen keepHosts dual with requiredRegions=[havenhythe,anachronia]. Current primary-havenhythe + empty req stands until that recipe lock.

walls.name: Orthen furnace core craft consumable map (Desert hard gate)
walls.question: User hard-gates Desert on Orthen furnace craft pressure. Wiki craft list is mostly tradeable consumables (extra fine sand, vital sparks, swamp tar, etc.) — confirm Desert remains a hard requiredRegion vs optional_pressure when ironman self-source map is normalised. Until contradicted, honour user Wildy+Desert+Anachronia on Masterwork plate → Orthen stack.

outOfScopeSingleHome.note: Single-home anachronia piece row — not a multi-host wall; leave alone
